about.heading: about
paragraphs: placeholder is a weekly email event calendar of unique events happening in san francisco.
we're run by a small team that hand picks local, in-person events that seek to provide meaningful experiences to those who attend.

curation.heading: curation
paragraphs: we're just starting out but expect the unexpected. do not expect to see large concerts, club event nights

subscribing.heading: subscribing
paragraphs: we only use your email to send you placeholder events once a week, nothing else.
your information is stored into a private database which is accessed by our mailer, nothing else.

items.question: who the fuck designed this website?
items.answer: that would be us, thank you.

items.question: why the fuck did you design this website?
what kind of events can i expect from placeholder?
can i submit an event?
items.answer: there's an event submission page on this website, but please consider the types of events that we curate

items.question: i submitted an event and it wasn't listed. how come?
items.answer: although we love all events, some just don't align with our mission. if you believe that there was a mistake, reach out to us at our email.

items.question: do you have any influences?
items.answer: absolutely. this project was conceptualized at the summer of ludd during a very specific and amazing panel. i thank them and still look up to them fondly.

items.question: do you currently/plan to make money from this?
answer: as of right now, this project is all funded by our team as a hobby. we all love events and see it as a way of giving back.
as time goes on we might adopt a patron subscription model for those who want to support what we do, while keeping the core of the project free for everyone.
we love www.nts.live and how they currenly finance their platform. check them out if you're unfamiliar.
